# Pharmacology
All drugs are administered into the bloodstream and act deterministically. The effect depends on concentration, liver and kidney state, interactions, and elimination time.
## Application order
1. Scan the patient. 2. Open the [color=#58e6d9]Drugs[/color] tab. 3. Check active drugs and toxic load. 4. Administer the selected drug. 5. Re-scan after the state updates.
## Drugs
- [color=#58e6d9]Trauma analgesic[/color] — increases analgesia; also provides mild sedation. Use: pain and preparation for surgery. - [color=#58e6d9]Surgical anesthetic[/color] — increases analgesia, sedation, and anesthesia; reduces motor activity and respiratory transfer. Use: deep surgery. - [color=#58e6d9]Sedative[/color] — increases sedation and reduces motor activity. Use: movement control before intervention. - [color=#58e6d9]Vasopressor[/color] — increases cardiac output. Use: low perfusion and vascular collapse. - [color=#58e6d9]Antiarrhythmic[/color] — increases rhythm stability. Use: electrical cardiac instability. - [color=#58e6d9]Respiratory stimulant[/color] — increases respiratory transfer and oxygenation. Use: breathing is preserved but suppressed. - [color=#58e6d9]Broad antibiotic[/color] — suppresses wound infection growth. Use: infected or contaminated wound. - [color=#58e6d9]Antitoxin[/color] — accelerates removal of systemic toxic load. Use: poisoning. - [color=#58e6d9]Procoagulant[/color] — reduces the actual rate of external and internal bleeding. Use: active blood loss. - [color=#58e6d9]Stimulant[/color] — increases alertness, cardiac output, and respiratory transfer. Use: depressed consciousness with preserved physiology. - [color=#58e6d9]Anticoagulant[/color] — increases bleeding. Use: special clinical indication. - [color=#58e6d9]Vasodilator[/color] — reduces cardiac output. Use: special clinical indication. - [color=#58e6d9]Immunosuppressant[/color] — suppresses the immune response and accelerates infectious deterioration. Use: support for a compatible transplant. - [color=#58e6d9]Synthetic oxygen carrier[/color] — increases oxygen transfer by the blood. Use: insufficient oxygen-carrying capacity of circulating blood. - [color=#58e6d9]Cyberware coolant agent[/color] — distributes among compatible implants and reduces overheating. Use: overheated cyberware.
## Interactions
- Sedative + surgical anesthetic: stronger therapeutic and toxic effects. - Trauma analgesic + sedative: higher toxicity. - Stimulant or respiratory stimulant + sedative: weaker therapeutic effect and higher toxicity. - Vasopressor + vasodilator: mutual weakening of therapeutic effect. - Procoagulant + anticoagulant: mutual weakening of therapeutic effect and higher toxicity.
Toxic load worsens shock, brain, heart, and respiratory function. Liver and kidney damage slow drug elimination.
